Sachet packaging manufacturer from Vapi for pharmaceutical companies and contract packagers. As a strip sachet packaging manufacturer from India, we supply APET and pharma-grade packaging components for domestic pharmaceutical and for export.

Strip and sachet packaging for pharmaceuticals covers thermoformed secondary packaging components for strip-packed tablets, unit-dose sachets, powder sachets, and granule sachets. Trizen manufactures the thermoformed packaging component — secondary packaging trays for strip-packed tablets, sachet secondary holders, and unit-dose secondary packaging inserts. Drug filling, sachet sealing, and batch printing are performed by the pharmaceutical manufacturer.

strips.title: Strip-Pack Dispensing Sequence — Strips Must Be Accessible for Dispensing
strips.desc: Problem: Strip-pack secondary packaging trays where the strip orientation does not align with the dispensing direction — strips must be pulled from the tray from the starting strip, not from a random strip. Solution: Strip pack secondary tray designed with strips aligned in dispensing sequence — first strip dispensed first.

strips.title: Sachet Damage in Secondary Packaging — Sachet Seal Integrity
strips.desc: Problem: Sachet secondary packaging where sachets are stacked without individual support can cause sachet seal stress under secondary packaging stack loads — sachet seal integrity compromised. Solution: Sachet secondary packaging tray with individual position support for each sachet — no sachet-to-sachet contact under any stack load.

strips.title: APET Pharma-Grade — Drug Contact Compatibility for Strip Secondary Packaging
strips.desc: Problem: Standard APET thermoforming materials are not qualified for pharmaceutical drug-adjacent applications — the additive specification may not be compatible with pharmaceutical stability testing. Solution: Pharma-grade APET with controlled additive specification — CoA per batch confirming pharma-grade specification for pharmaceutical secondary packaging.
